design: Retrospective later-origin evaluation; all origins previously viewed, not independent heldout data. No tuning/search after scoring.
warmup: All preceding available origins; later origins may use matured earlier later-origin residuals.
base_and_archive: Both global and grouped use identical drift base and historical drift-only residual archive. Current-v1 reference uses drift base and original mixed-policy archive.
maturity: origin_date < current origin_date and target_date < current origin_date
adjustment: nonnegative tail expansion; q10 floor zero; q50 unchanged
evaluation: Official scorer only, common exact later-origin cells, last_value and drift baselines; pooled/mean/median/geomean skill, coverage and width; group and series contributions and leave-one-series-out

bootstrap.caveat: Only five origin clusters, dependent series/time, retrospective selection; descriptive only

promotion_gate: grouped-minus-global AND grouped-minus-current-v1 official paired mean pinball CI upper < 0; grouped mean-series skill vs drift >= both comparators AND >= 0; if passes save separate forecasts_group_calibrated.csv; never overwrite forecasts.csv or forecasts_calibrated.csv
